rule_0.statement: THE GLIDE-RETURN LAW (wave 31). The wave-30 central measurement: after the 142 alternation fire the L pads NEVER re-enter the touch band (pair-min 11.5 mm at the 151 replant event, 11.5 mm at 155, diverging to 56 mm by 200, rxn 0) -- the replant is a CLOCK event with no touchdown, and the fold's resumption (155) is the glide-return MISS. This lane derives the miss's anatomy, ships ONE law that makes the haul-back DELIVER the pads into the touch band, and re-runs the fence. THREE PARTS. (1) THE MISS'S ANATOMY, MINED on the lane-setup reproduction trace (the byte-exact 16e5b5a5 baseline): the hind step's TD plant pin is hind_step_plant_y_ = the LIFTOFF paw height measured at the fire tick (not the fore machinery's settle-era capture key), so the settle-era staleness hypothesis (the wave-20 body-sink making a settle-banked pin stale) is tested arithmetically: PIN ERROR = the fire's plant_y minus the plane-touch height at the fire vs DELIVERY ERROR = the actual pad height at the clock TD minus the plant target. The glide's IK self-check at the fire (qerr 4.4e-16) says the pin is self-consistent; the measured pad series says the arch's tail descent (-2.7 mm/tick commanded) is under-tracked (the pad PEAKS 13.1 mm at 150 and descends 0.2-0.45 mm/tick). Decision rule, fixed BEFORE the formal decomposition run: if the PIN error owns the miss (~11.5 mm), the law is (a) THE LIVE-PLANE RE-PIN (the TD target's vertical re-anchors to the current plane/band); if the DELIVERY error owns it with the pin fresh, (b) THE DESCENT PROFILE is REJECTED (steepening a descent the servo already under-tracks substitutes a tuned number for a law) and the law is (c) THE CAPTURE-CONDITION FIX: A REPLANT IS NOT COMPLETE UNTIL THE BAND ENTRY -- the clock's TD (hind_step_t_ >= tair) no longer completes the replant by itself; the leg HOLDS the plant point (the glide's own sg clamp at 1 already commands exactly the plant target, zero new constants) until the pair-min pads gap <= kTouch (the wave-22 touch class), and ONLY THEN does the replant complete (mode 0, the tds counter, the wave-22 crossing re-syncs phi_[leg]=0 at the same class crossing the touch law already owns). (2) THE PREDICTED CALENDAR: the fence bytes through 150 are IDENTICAL (the R's 98 fire and 107 replant complete exactly as shipped: the R's pads were measured in-band from 104, so the new band-entry condition is TRUE at the shipped completion tick); the FIRST DIVERGENCE IS EXACTLY TICK 151 (the baseline completed the L replant at 151 with the pads 12.9 mm high; the law holds the plant). The L's touchdown tick (the first band entry) is bounded BELOW by 152 and ABOVE by the kinematic ceiling 172: the wave-29 mirrored behind-reach envelope measured 21.7 ticks of budget at tick 151, so a replant not delivered by 151+21 = 172 dies as a NEW honestly-named face (the reach-clamped tow). The point estimate is 160 +/- 6 from the descent physics: the initial vertical error 12.9 mm maps to a knee error ~0.086 rad (the 0.182 shank lever), the mass-normalized knee demand kp*e ~ 2.1 N.m with kp=m*omega^2 (omega 25.13, zeta 0.8), the shank inertia about the knee giving alpha ~ 100-300 rad/s^2 against the kd 2*zeta*m*omega damping -- an 8-17 tick convergence, faster than the tables-era fighting descent (0.35 mm/tick floor, which the stale-phase toe-off columns caused) because the held plant target commands NO opposing column. (3) THE PREDICTIONS: (i) the two-legged ride RESUMES at the completion (the L touching by completion+3, rxn returning); (ii) the fold class (a pads-leave while not in glide and phi < TOE_OFF) is ABSENT through the ride or its first tick is pushed past the resumption; (iii) the alternation's natural cadence resumes: the R's next fire is its SLOT (phi_R re-synced at its 105-107 crossing -> TOE_OFF 0.68 at ~252 +/- 3), the L's next fire its slot after its own re-sync (~305 +/- 3); (iv) the refusal passes 299 (the rung banks) or dies on a NEW, honestly-named face; (v) F-G1..G3 become measurable only past 649.
